author: eQuantic
name: eQuantic.UI web app
description: A write-once eQuantic.UI app: C# components compiled to JavaScript at build time — no Node, no bundlers. Pick a starting shape with --shell. Run it with `dotnet run`.

shell.description: The layout the app starts from. A shell here is an ordinary component every page composes — there is no Layout type to register.

choices.description: One page and a counter — the write-once claim, and nothing to delete.
A header with links across the top, and a second route to prove the router.
A sidebar past 840dp, the same sections wrapped under the header below it.
